mapper.select: SELECT record_version FROM customer.customer_master WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND record_status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE new_contract.insurance_application SET policy_no=#{policyNo},policy_no_assigned_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), record_version=record_version+1,updated_by='local-tester',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo} AND policy_no IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT a.application_no,a.policy_no,a.policy_no_assigned_at,a.application_status, a.application_date,a.requested_effective_date,a.channel_code,a.branch_code,a.insurance_agent_code, a.product_code,a.product_version,a.payment_mode_code,a.currency_code, a.sum_assured_amount,a.premium_amount, ap.customer_id applicant_customer_id,ac.customer_name applicant_name, ip.customer_id insured_customer_id,ic.customer_name insured_name FROM new_contract.insurance_application a JOIN new_contract.application_party ap ON ap.application_no=a.application_no AND ap.party_role_code='APPLICANT' JOIN customer.customer_master ac ON ac.customer_id=ap.customer_id JOIN new_contract.application_party ip ON ip.application_no=a.application_no AND ip.party_role_code='INSURED' JOIN customer.customer_master ic ON ic.customer_id=ip.customer_id WHERE a.application_no=#{query} OR a.policy_no=#{query} OR ap.customer_id=#{query} OR ip.customer_id=#{query} ORDER BY a.application_date DESC,a.created_at DESC

SELECT coverage_item_seq,coverage_item_type,product_code,product_version,currency_code,sum_assured_amount,premium_amount,coverage_term_years,premium_payment_term_years,requested_effective_date FROM new_contract.application_coverage WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo} ORDER BY coverage_item_seq

SELECT beneficiary_type_code,beneficiary_seq,beneficiary_customer_id,beneficiary_designation_code,priority_no,allocation_percentage,relationship_to_insured_code FROM new_contract.application_beneficiary WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo} ORDER BY beneficiary_type_code,beneficiary_seq

SELECT question_set_code,question_set_version,disclosure_question_code,answer_code_encrypted,supplemental_detail_encrypted,answered_at,confirmed_at FROM new_contract.health_disclosure WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo} ORDER BY disclosure_question_code

SELECT declaration_type_code,declaration_version,confirmed_by_party_role,confirmation_method,confirmed_at FROM new_contract.application_declaration WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo} ORDER BY declaration_type_code
SELECT signer_party_role,signer_customer_id,signature_method,signed_at,verified_at FROM new_contract.application_signature WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo} ORDER BY signer_party_role

SELECT p.party_role_code,c.contact_type_code,c.contact_value_masked,c.is_primary,c.verification_status,c.effective_from,c.effective_to FROM new_contract.application_party p JOIN customer.customer_contact c ON c.customer_id=p.customer_id WHERE p.application_no=#{applicationNo} ORDER BY p.party_role_code,c.contact_type_code,c.is_primary DESC

SELECT p.party_role_code,a.address_type_code,a.postal_code,a.address_masked,a.effective_from,a.effective_to FROM new_contract.application_party p JOIN customer.customer_address a ON a.customer_id=p.customer_id WHERE p.application_no=#{applicationNo} ORDER BY p.party_role_code,a.address_type_code

SELECT premium_due_id,currency_code,calculated_premium_amount,calculation_rule_version,due_status,calculated_at FROM new_contract.initial_premium_due WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo} ORDER BY application_revision DESC

SELECT application_no, premium_due_id, currency_code, calculated_premium_amount, calculation_rule_version, due_status FROM new_contract.initial_premium_due WHERE application_no=( SELECT application_no FROM new_contract.insurance_application WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo} OR policy_no=#{applicationNo} LIMIT 1 ) AND due_status='PENDING' ORDER BY application_revision DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE new_contract.remittance_slip SET remittance_status=#{status} WHERE remittance_slip_id=#{id}
UPDATE new_contract.initial_premium_due SET due_status=#{status} WHERE premium_due_id=#{id}

UPDATE new_contract.insurance_application SET initial_premium_match_status=#{status}, application_status=CASE WHEN #{status}='MATCHED' THEN #{readyStatus} ELSE application_status END, initial_premium_matched_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='MATCHED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END, record_version=record_version+1,updated_by='local-tester',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_contract.insurance_application WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo}
SELECT application_no FROM new_contract.insurance_application WHERE application_no=#{number} OR policy_no=#{number} LIMIT 1
SELECT policy_no FROM new_contract.insurance_application WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo}

SELECT batch_execution_id,business_date,process_status AS execution_status,started_at,completed_at,total_count, approved_count,inquiry_count,failed_count FROM new_contract.underwriting_batch_execution ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT a.application_no,a.policy_no,u.underwriting_case_no,u.underwriting_status, u.underwriting_decision_code,u.contract_status_code,u.record_version FROM new_contract.insurance_application a JOIN new_contract.underwriting_case u ON u.application_no=a.application_no WHERE a.application_no=#{query} OR a.policy_no=#{query} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE new_contract.underwriting_case SET underwriting_status=#{stageCode},underwriting_decision_code=#{decisionCode}, contract_status_code=#{contractStatusCode},decision_reason_code=#{reasonCode}, underwriter_id=#{underwriterId},underwritten_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), record_version=record_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE underwriting_case_no=#{caseNo} AND record_version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT p.policy_no,p.application_no,p.underwriting_case_no,p.policy_status,p.effective_date, p.record_version policy_version,a.application_status,a.record_version application_version, u.underwriting_status,u.record_version underwriting_version FROM main.policy_contract p JOIN new_contract.insurance_application a ON a.application_no=p.application_no JOIN new_contract.underwriting_case u ON u.underwriting_case_no=p.underwriting_case_no WHERE p.policy_no=#{policyNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.policy_contract WHERE policy_no=#{policyNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM main.policy_contract WHERE policy_no=#{policyNo} AND record_version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE new_contract.insurance_application SET application_status=#{applicationStatus},validation_result_status=NULL, validation_completed_at=NULL,validation_batch_id=NULL,completed_at=NULL,record_version=record_version+1, updated_by='local-tester',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE application_no=#{applicationNo} AND record_version=#{version}

UPDATE new_contract.underwriting_case SET underwriting_status=#{underwritingStatus},underwriting_decision_code=NULL, underwriter_id=NULL,decision_reason_code=NULL,underwritten_at=NULL,policy_no=NULL, record_version=record_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE underwriting_case_no=#{caseNo} AND record_version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO new_contract.policy_issuance_reversal_audit (reversal_audit_id,policy_no,application_no,underwriting_case_no,reason_code,reason_description, operator_id,request_id,before_content,after_content,before_content_hash,after_content_hash,occurred_at) VALUES (#{auditId},#{policyNo},#{applicationNo},#{caseNo},#{reasonCode},#{reasonDescription}, 'local-tester',#{requestId},CAST(#{beforeJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{afterJson} AS JSON), #{beforeHash},#{afterHash},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
